text: Big day: a €18 million Series A led by Raviqa.
Hooly raises €18 million Series A led by Raviqa Capital
Hooly, the company behind Hooly Gemini, today announced a €18 million Series A financing round led by Raviqa Capital.
“Hooly has the rare combination of a product customers trust and a team that ships every quarter.” said Laurie Breem, partner at Raviqa Capital.
Hooly has closed its Series A: €18 million, led by Raviqa Capital.
On 24 March 2026 in Berlin we launched Hooly Gemini 2.0.
